title: Strict JSON Observation
description: The shape experiment 3 forces the model to fill. Sent VERBATIM as Gemini's generationConfig.responseSchema, so it stays inside the OpenAPI subset that endpoint accepts: no $schema, no $defs, no additionalProperties, no oneOf. It is also the schema the response is validated against locally, by the repo's own vendored validator — asking the provider to honour a schema and checking that it did are two different acts, and the lab does both. Vocabulary is OPEN: `quality` is a free string, because a closed list of fold-words would hard-code one rehearsal's topic into the instrument that is supposed to be able to fail on it.

confidence_is_not_measurement.description: The model must restate that its answer is interpretive. A model that cannot emit this constant has not been held to the contract.

refusals.description: What the model declined to claim from these images. An empty array is a claim in itself and is recorded as one.
